notes.note: Clark was the link man across half back getting involved in plenty of play chains. 25 touches at 92% for his first 100+ since round 16.
21 disposals for Clark across half back at a very handy 90% efficiency.
Clark copped the defensive tag from Murdock this week and he was held to his second lowest score of the season so far from his 18 disposals.
22 touches at 81% for Clark. This makes it three in the 90s in a row as he has been a solid contributor.
Clark slotted a goal to go with his 23 disposals as this makes it three over 90 in a row now which is positive for owners.
Clark dropped back below 100 making this three in the last four now. 23 disposals at 87% for him this week.
This was just his second over 100 in the last 9 weeks. He did have 24 disposals as the Dockers dominated this game. He may be a risk to trade into until we see this more regularly.
This was the lowest we have seen from Clark since round 4 as he had 17 disposals and 5 marks. There was a very even spread of points across the Dockers.
The ball wasn't in Clark's area too often leading to him dropping back below 100 this week.
24 touches for Clark for his first over 100 in the last 6 games. A solid outing as the Dockers controlled that part of the ground.

It's been 5 scores under 100 now for Clark in a row since that huge score in round 6. He put up 18 disposals at 88%  in what was a fairly even scoring game from Fremantle. Don't jump off but we may look to upgrade across the byes.
Clark had his best score in the last four weeks  from his 22 disposals.
Clark has now had three in a row under 90 which came from 19 disposals. His value is dropping as is his average.
After his great run his last two haven't been fantastic for Clark owners. But 3 free kicks against did hurt his score. Not time to move him but he is a watch.
Clark's run of great scoring has been interrupted by this week's 25 disposal 6 mark game. He seems to have a quieter score every few weeks recently but he should be ok to hold.
Clark top scored for the game by a big margin. Despite two poor scores he has had a good season other than that. He is still looking a good option.
Clark seems to have returned to the high possession game we have seen and apart from the previous week's poor one he has been scoring well. His price is dropping so keep an eye on him.
Clark has now put together two great games in a row and is looking to be back to the scoring we saw a couple of seasons ago. 27 disposals at 81% for him this week in the wet.
